result.force_convention: Tension positive; effective tension = wall tension - Pi*Ai + Po*Ao using absolute pressures. M10 buoyed-force baseline already effective.
limitations: No operational WOB limit, certification, or equipment command.
Long-pipe thresholds omit end restraint, residual curvature, tortuosity, tool joints, torque, rotation and dynamics.
Ideal helix contact is a conditional axial-load scenario; sinusoidal post-buckling contact and 3D nonlinear beam/contact are not solved.
Ten characteristic wavelengths is an eligibility guard, not evidence that boundary effects vanish.
M10 is an unqualified soft-string load baseline. Supplied wall forces need independent equilibrium and pressure-reference evidence.

load_transfer.boundary_condition: Prescribed interval bottom effective force; upward axial-slip equilibrium; unrestrained helix.

reasons: Local compression reaches a selected buckling screen within the tested uncertainty envelope.
result.scope: Offline straight inclined uniform plain pipe; Dawson–Paslay sinusoidal and Chen–Cheatham helical estimates. Local effective compression, not surface or bit WOB.
